name: com.ugoe.unity
description: Display and animate ugoe (.ugoe) 2D rigged models in Unity. The model is evaluated by the ugoe native library (C ABI) and drawn with Unity meshes and materials.

author.name: Sho KUSANO and the ugoe contributors

samples.description: A scene that shows a model with parameter sliders, expressions, motions, dress-up modules and a light that follows the mouse.
